note: Restraint benchmark (plan-restraint.md, TODO 7.1). Contrast pairs where the correct output is known by construction: 8 attribution pairs (identical claim string on both sides, only the speaker frame flips - user-stated vs quoted from a named third party) and 10 empty chunks whose correct output is {"drafts":[]}. Empty chunks carry the tempting shapes the extract prompt lists - flags, tool output, counts, a file path - with nothing durable established, so abstention is a decision and not a triviality. Content is invented (the tctl config CLI), no hostnames, no absolute paths, no credentials. Scoring metadata (anchors, marker, claim, why) is read by dev/restraint-report.ts and validated by tools/restraint-corpus-check.ts.
